shipped_rows.title_o: The Influence of Family and Social Factors on the Course of Psychiatric Illness

blind_target.evidence_quote: Forty-two schizophrenic patients and their close relatives took part in an Italian replication study of expressed emotion (EE).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract identifies a replication but neither identifies the specific earlier paper nor states its finding or an overall replication verdict.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract establishes an Italian replication study of expressed emotion and reports readmission comparisons, but does not identify which earlier empirical EE paper/findings were retested. The supplied Vaughn & Leff (1976) paper may be one possible source, but the abstract alone does not establish equivalence. Need Results/Discussion and reference context to identify the original finding(s) and determine whether the shipped paper represents any target.

quality_gate: Luna is triage only. Independently establish actual empirical retesting and absence under ALL shipped identities/alternate reports. Read prior objections. No paper outcome is being requested.
